observations: Photo 0 shows a black metal X-style keyboard stand with four legs, placed on a tiled floor against a textured wall.
Photo 1 shows a keyboard on the stand, with a beige and black front panel, white and black keys, and a small display screen. The keyboard appears to be in a room with a textured wall and tiled floor.

Photo 2 shows a top-down view of the same keyboard, revealing the control panel with buttons, a small LCD screen, and a speaker grille. The keyboard is beige with black keys and a black control panel. The brand name is visible on the lower right of the panel.
The keyboard has a standard 61-key layout, typical of a CTK 4200 model.
The stand is black metal, with a cross-braced design, and appears to be in good condition with no visible damage.
The keyboard shows some minor scuffs and dust, especially on the keys and panel, but no major damage is visible.
No power adapter or stand is visible in any photo.
